name: VM / Deployment
description: Tuned for virtual machines and image deployment: strips telemetry, ads and bloat; maximises performance (visual effects, High Performance power plan, no hibernate, SysMain off, faster menus, foreground priority); enables Remote Desktop; skips the first-logon animation; and bypasses the Microsoft-account requirement at OOBE so the image deploys to a local account. Review the Remote Desktop and OOBE items for your environment. Pair with 'Export for deployment' or apply to an offline image.
